teaser: Map every layer from the hardware to the business contract by who signs it; the lines nobody signs are the blind spots worth paying to see.
core_idea: A maintainer's signature names who stands behind a version, not what is running; extending Andrey Lazarev's split between measured and declared context, every layer from hardware to business contract should end in an accountable signer, forming a fractal graph of signed certificates in which unsigned lines are visible blind spots for businesses and insurers to accept or close, with experts paid to sign and departures exposed.

quotes.text: The honest certificate keeps the two kinds apart, and names the signer of each.

quotes.text: The line goes from signed to blind spot, and everyone can see it.
